user.title: Connect your sensors
user.description: Select the ESPHome weight sensor and the sensor entity that publishes scanned barcodes.

weight_entity.name: Weight sensor
weight_entity.description: Choose the stable weight sensor from your ESPHome scale.

barcode_entity.name: Barcode entity
barcode_entity.description: Choose the sensor containing the last scanned barcode, for example sensor.barcode_scanner_last_barcode.

error.invalid_weight_entity: Select a registered ESPHome weight sensor.
error.invalid_barcode_entity: Select a sensor entity registered in Home Assistant.

init.title: Food Diary settings
init.description: Choose the connected sensor entities and adjust the weighing workflow and product lookup.

weight_entity.name: Weight sensor
weight_entity.description: ESPHome stable weight sensor used for automatic portion capture.

auto_save.name: Save automatically
auto_save.description: Save a known product when a new stable positive weight is detected.

weight_timeout_seconds.name: Weight timeout
weight_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a stable weight after scanning.

zero_threshold_g.name: Zero threshold
zero_threshold_g.description: Weight values at or below this number of grams are treated as zero.

openfoodfacts_enabled.name: Use Open Food Facts
openfoodfacts_enabled.description: Look up barcodes not present in the local catalogue.

openfoodfacts_country.name: Open Food Facts country
openfoodfacts_country.description: Two-letter country code, for example it.

openfoodfacts_language.name: Product language
openfoodfacts_language.description: Language code used for product lookup, for example it.

barcode_entity.name: Barcode entity
barcode_entity.description: Sensor publishing the last barcode read by the GM67 or another scanner.

add_food.name: Add food
add_food.description: Add a food to the local catalogue.

source.name: Source
source.description: Where the product data came from.

nutrients_per_100g.name: Nutrients per 100 g
nutrients_per_100g.description: Known nutrient values; omit unknown values.

update_food.name: Update food
update_food.description: Update a catalogue item. Omitted nutrient fields are preserved.

food_id.name: Food ID
food_id.description: ID returned by a Food Diary action.

brand.name: Brand
brand.description: New brand; an empty value clears it.

barcode.name: Barcode
barcode.description: New barcode; an empty value clears it.

nutrients_per_100g.name: Nutrients per 100 g
nutrients_per_100g.description: Only supplied nutrient keys are changed; null clears a value.

delete_food.name: Delete food
delete_food.description: Delete a food from the catalogue. Existing diary entries keep their snapshots.

search_foods.name: Search foods
search_foods.description: Search the local catalogue by product name or brand.

query.name: Search text
query.description: Text to find in the product name or brand.

limit.name: Maximum results
limit.description: Maximum number of results, from 1 to 500.

find_food_by_barcode.name: Find food by barcode
find_food_by_barcode.description: Find a known catalogue item by its exact barcode.

add_entry.name: Add diary entry
add_entry.description: Save one weighed portion to the diary.

consumed_at.name: Consumed at
consumed_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp including UTC offset.

list_entries.name: List diary entries
list_entries.description: Return entries in a half-open ISO 8601 time range.

start.name: Start
start.description: Inclusive start timestamp with UTC offset.

end.name: End
end.description: Exclusive end timestamp with UTC offset.

delete_entry.name: Delete diary entry
delete_entry.description: Delete one diary portion by its entry ID.

period_summary.name: Get period summary
period_summary.description: Return daily, weekly, or monthly totals in the selected IANA timezone.

period.name: Period
period.description: Calendar day, Monday-to-Sunday week, or calendar month.

anchor_date.name: Anchor date
anchor_date.description: Date used to select the day, week, or month.
